title: StockX Price Snapshot Lowest Ask Leaderboard
dataSources: StockX market prices (`stockx:price`), GOAT listings (`goat:listing`), Alias sales (`alias:sale`), sneaker rotation logs (`sneaker:rotation`), and deadstock age checks (`deadstock:age`).
app: StockX price alerts, GOAT listing exports, Alias seller settlement logs, sneaker rotation wear trackers, and deadstock age audits ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=stockx:price lowest_ask_usd=*
| stats sum(lowest_ask_usd) as total_value, avg(lowest_ask_usd) as avg_value by sku
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks SKU values by total and average lowest ask across StockX price snapshot events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `lowest_ask_usd` values for each StockX price snapshot event and review total and average lowest ask by SKU.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total lowest ask.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which SKU shows the biggest lowest ask numbers in your StockX price snapshot data.
